root.label: Sterling Pharmaceutical Services initiates eye drops recall

events.label: Sterling Pharmaceutical Services initiates eye drops recall

slots.name: recalled units
slots.sentence: The recall covers nine products and 747,844 units in total.

slots.name: recalled products
slots.sentence: The recall includes nine products, including lubricant eye drops, a hypertonicity eye solution and a nighttime eye ointment.

slots.name: recall date
slots.sentence: Sterling Pharmaceutical Services LLC, based in Dupo, Illinois, initiated the recall Aug. 20, 2026, according to an Aug. 20 FDA enforcement report.
